title: Constructibility of localizing exceptional cohomology
statement: Fix a universe $u$, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes in universe $u$, and $g:Z\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication and a certificate of one of the three adic coefficient families [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]; the algebraic-closure coefficient has the finite-subextension-valued meaning of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For $T=Z,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and let $\mathcal B_T$ be its bounded constructible full subcategory [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], using constructibility in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense [def-sfb-constructible-module]. Let $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full localizing hull formed with ambient coproducts indexed in universe $u+1$ [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure], and $F_g:\mathcal L_Z\to\mathcal L_Y$ the canonical restriction of the actual ambient $Rg_*$ [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-pushforward]. For every functor $G:\mathcal L_Y\to\mathcal L_Z$, every supplied adjunction $F_g\dashv G$, every $K\in\mathcal B_Y$, and every integer $n$, the module $H^n(G(K))$ in $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Z}$ is constructible in the sense of [def-sfb-constructible-module]. Here $K$ enters $\mathcal L_Y$ by the canonical full inclusion, and cohomology is taken after the full inclusion $\mathcal L_Z\hookrightarrow D_Z$. No derived-completeness condition is imposed.

lean.statement: theorem ellAdic_localizing_rightAdjoint_obj_homology_constructible (G : (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory ⥤ (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory) (adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Λ ℓ g hΛ ⊣ G) (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) : ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj ((G.obj ((boundedConstructibleToLocalizing Λ Y.left).obj K)).obj))

proof.text: The field $k$ is Noetherian since its only ideals are $(0)$ and $(1)$. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] makes $Z,Y$ Noetherian and quasi-compact. They are quasi-separated: their separated diagonals are closed immersions, which on affine charts are spectra of quotients and hence quasi-compact. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal], a descending closed chain has a minimal term and stabilizes. Thus their spaces, and every subspace given by a locally closed stratum, are Noetherian.

proof.text: The qcqs hypothesis in step 1 lets [det-def-localizing-closure-ctf-equals-bc] give $\Dbc=\Dctf$. The hull definitions [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure; sk-def-localizing-closure] now intersect the same properties containing the same generators, with the same ambient $u+1$-indexed coproducts. Hence $\mathcal L_T=\Loc(\Dctf(T,\Lambda))$.

proof.text: Let $J=g^!$ and $Rg_!\dashv J$ be supplied by [sk-prop-sf-existence]. Properness gives $Rg_!\cong Rg_*|_{\mathcal L_Z}$ by [det-cor-existence-ii-restriction](1), whose right side is the actual $F_g$ of [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-pushforward]. Apply [lem-sfb-adjunction-transport-left-iso] to obtain $F_g\dashv J$ on exactly these hulls.

source.place: Part (2), geometric restriction for the adic coefficient cases

proof.text: The certificate [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate] has three cases. For $E$ and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, [sk-thm-restriction] gives $J(K)\in\Dctf(Z,\Lambda)$. For $\mathcal O_E$, [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint] identifies the integral Brown adjoint with $J$ under step 3, and [sk-thm-int-restriction] gives the same conclusion. The schemes and $k$ have the standing hypotheses, and the proper $k$-morphism $g$ is separated of finite type.

source.place: Part (2), geometric restriction for the adic coefficient cases

proof.text: By [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], $G(K)\cong J(K)$ in the hull, hence in $D_Z$. Applying $H^n$ gives isomorphic modules. Step 5 and step 2 make $H^n(J(K))$ constructible. Its stratification also works for $H^n(G(K))$: pull back the isomorphism to each presentation cover and compose the cokernel-presentation isomorphism with its inverse, as in [def-sfb-constructible-module]. This proves the claim for every $n$.
